help: the check suite over src/ and rsc/ - code and schema, the same on any clone; the corpus is the data gate's (corpus-yoga pipeline run) (also what the pre-commit hook runs); SENDS two requests to github to check the pinned MCP schema, and, when a docker daemon is reachable, a fetch of upstream and a container run to reproduce it (mcp.reproducible); YOGA_NO_SEND=1 refuses all of them without failing the run

args.name: --fix
args.help: run every fix command, then stop — stages nothing (review and stage yourself)

args.name: --fresh
args.help: ignore the section cache: re-run every check (the cache stat-hashes each section's declared subject; unchanged sections replay)

urllib.request.urlopen: one GET of the pinned MCP schema's upstream URL (currency of the lineage file) and one GET of upstream's schema/ directory listing (newest dated lineage); YOGA_NO_SEND=1 skips both without failing the run (may_send)
src/main/mcp/reproduce.sh (git fetch of: mcp.reproducible: upstream's generator over the committed schema.ts, diffed against the committed schema.json - run only when a docker daemon is reachable; YOGA_NO_SEND=1 or no daemon skips it without failing the run (may_send)
